lines.zh: 我贴着地走，背上的甲片一晃。
lines.en: I walk low, the plates on my back shifting.
My four legs are short and I go slowly.

lines.zh: 我沿着一排蕨类走过去。
lines.en: I walk along a line of ferns.

lines.zh: 我背上的甲片碰到草，沙沙响。
lines.en: My plates rasp against the grass.

lines.zh: 我绕开一块石头，步子很小。
lines.en: I step around a stone in small paces.

lines.zh: 我在河边走，脚陷进泥里。
lines.en: I walk the riverbank, feet sinking in mud.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴拖着，后面留着印。
lines.en: My tail drags and leaves a line behind.

lines.zh: 我一步一步挪，很有耐性。
lines.en: I shift step by step, patiently.
I pass through a patch of low scrub.

lines.zh: 我绕了一圈，回到原来的路。
lines.en: I circle and come back to the same path.
I head for the sunny clearing.

lines.zh: 我把身子侧过去，挤过灌木。
lines.en: I turn sideways to squeeze past the brush.
I lie with my chin on the ground.

lines.zh: 我的甲片在太阳下有点热。
lines.en: The plates on my back are warm in the sun.
Chewing slowly, swallowing slow.

lines.zh: 这里没有别的东西，只有草。
lines.en: There's nothing but grass here.
I hear something making a noise.

lines.zh: 风把我的甲缝吹得发凉。
lines.en: The wind cools the gaps between my plates.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛很小，看不太远。
lines.en: My eyes are small and I can't see far.
I turn and settle again.

lines.zh: 我什么也不用做，今天很闲。
lines.en: I've nothing to do; today is idle.

lines.zh: 我把头抬起来，又放下去。
lines.en: I lift my head and set it down.
There are grubs in the soil; I'm not interested.
My back plates ring at the least touch.
Half asleep, I watch the grass sway.

lines.zh: 你从上往下看我，我抬不起头。
lines.en: You look down on me; I can't lift my head.

lines.zh: 我缩了一下，甲片都靠紧了。
lines.en: I shrink and my plates draw close.
I move slowly into the grass.

lines.zh: 你比我高得多，我够不到你。
lines.en: You're much taller; I can't reach you.

lines.zh: 我身上的甲是我唯一的依靠。
lines.en: This armor is all I have.
You don't look like a grazer.
I lower my head and hide it.
I take two slow steps forward.
I look at you, then at the grass.
This armor cost me nothing.

lines.zh: 我背上的沟也是新长的东西。
lines.en: The grooves on my back are new, too.
I curl up and close my plates.

lines.zh: 这一下打得我侧翻过去。
lines.en: That knocks me onto my side.
A crack has opened in my shell.
I lie still, breathing slowly.

lines.zh: 我拖着一条腿挪了两步。
lines.en: I drag a leg for two paces.
I press to the soil and don't move.
There's the smell of blood on me.

lines.zh: 甲片挡住大半，剩下我自己扛。
lines.en: The plates took most of it; I'll carry the rest.
I smell the grass you set down.

lines.zh: 我背上的甲片，磕得很响。
lines.en: The scutes on my back clatter.
Not enough to be worth the walk.
I eat and watch you.
I chew slowly; my teeth are poor.

lines.zh: 你再放一把，我就不走了。
lines.en: Another handful and I'll stay.
I hold the blades down with a foot and eat.
Finished, I look up and wait.
This is softer than what I usually get.

lines.zh: 你碰我一下，我就往外滑。
lines.en: You bump me and I slide away.
I back two paces and pull my head in.

lines.zh: 这一下撞在甲上，声音很闷。
lines.en: The knock on my plates is dull.
I flatten to the ground and stay.
I shift away from your feet.
We turn the soil over.
I crawl slowly back to my spot.
You're bigger; all I have is armor.
I shake the earth off my back.
The two of us lean together.

lines.zh: 她的甲片比我的小一些。
lines.en: Her plates are smaller than mine.
She rests her head against my shell.
We lie together in the mud.
Her tail is shorter than mine.
We move into the shade together.
She makes no sound, only leans.
At dusk we each settle down.
I bite down and pull up.
I can chew this much.

lines.zh: 我把它按在脚下慢慢啃。
lines.en: I pin it underfoot and gnaw.

lines.zh: 我叼着它，塞进灌木底下。
lines.en: I carry it off and stash it under a bush.
I sniff it and put it down.
My mouth is full of mud.
It takes me an age to swallow.
I leave half of it in the grass.
I'm not fussy; if it's food, I eat it.
I freeze and press myself low.
I pull my head down a little.
Every plate on my back is raised.
I don't run; I lie flat.
It's faster than me; running won't help.
I press my body to the soil.
I can't beat this one.
I shift behind a stone.
If it bites, I'll ram it.

lines.zh: 我把重心压在四条腿上。
lines.en: I settle my weight on all four legs.
I curl my tail in close.
It's only a few steps off.
If I move, it moves.
It follows a few steps.
There's a hollow behind the stone.
I squeeze slowly inside.
It's circling beside me.
My plates will take one hit.
I sweep my tail at it.

lines.zh: 我低下头，露出背上的甲片。
lines.en: I lower my head and show the plates on my back.
I take the chance to shift half a step.
It's still circling over there.
I lie still and pass for a rock.

lines.zh: 我背上的甲片，从没被咬穿过。
lines.en: Nothing has bitten through my plates.
I wait a long while before lifting my head.
I ram with my armored back.
It lands on its leg.
It steps back; I ram again.
One swipe flips me over.
On my back, all four legs kick.
I butt it once more.
It doesn't follow up.
I flatten and guard my belly.
I just barely held out.

lines.zh: 它扑过来，我缩成一块石头。
lines.en: It lunges; I go still as a rock.
The plates on my back are still wet.
I lie still at first.
I slowly put my head out.

lines.zh: 我沿着河岸慢慢走出来。
lines.en: I walk out slowly along the riverbank.
I try two steps of crawling.
The sun is warm on my back.
I head for the nearest clump.
I push through the ferns and show my head.
I've taken note of this ground.

lines.zh: 我的步子很小，可是不停。
lines.en: My steps are small, and they don't stop.

lines.zh: 我背上多了一处新长的沟。
lines.en: A new groove has grown on my back.
It chafes a little when I walk.
I move slowly toward the shade.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的甲，我往下钻。
lines.en: Fire heats my plates and I try to dig down.
I fall into a pit and land on my back.
Water reaches my shell and I flounder.

lines.zh: 冲击把土连同我一起掀开。
lines.en: The blast throws me up with the soil.

lines.zh: 一根尖东西卡在甲缝里。
lines.en: Something sharp lodges between my plates.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的腿都僵住。
lines.en: The light locks my legs.
Too starved to crawl, I lie down.

lines.zh: 雷落在背甲上，麻了半边。
lines.en: Lightning hits my shell and half of me goes numb.
No soil; I tumble down and down.
